Metadata.title: Digital Ordering & Multi-Branch Operations Platform
Metadata.description: Create instant QR ordering experiences for any venue, and manage menus, orders, branches, and analytics from a unified dashboard with DineHub.
Metadata.ogDescription: Zero-app, zero-signup ordering for guests, with total operational command for your team across branches.

Hero.intro: From scan to service, in one seamless flow
Hero.titleLine2: And every branch stays in control.
Hero.lede: Guests scan a QR code, customize their preferences, and submit orders with zero apps or signups. Behind the scenes, your team commands menus, orders, branches, and analytics from a single unified hub.
Hero.heroImageAlt: DineHub digital ordering ecosystem showing guest mobile menu, POS order terminal, and live branch analytics

Flow.description: From scanning to order fulfillment, the entire journey remains swift and intuitive. Guests order with confidence, while staff receive clear, actionable orders.
Flow.step1Desc: Scanning the QR opens the interactive menu directly on their phone—no download or registration required.
Flow.step2Desc: Exact preferences, notes, dietary exclusions, and drink modifiers are captured with pinpoint precision.
Flow.step3Desc: Kitchen and service staff receive neatly structured orders on a touch-optimized screen, tracking status until fulfillment.

Showcase.description: A lightweight interface guides guests straight to checkout, paired with an operational engine that equips staff with everything they need.
Showcase.feature1Desc: Fast, categorized browsing that delivers a responsive, tactile experience on any screen size.
Showcase.feature1Alt: 3D visualization of a phone displaying a digital menu after scanning a QR code
Showcase.feature2Desc: Modifiers, portions, and bespoke instructions appear clearly within the order ticket—eliminating kitchen guesswork.
Showcase.feature2Alt: 3D visualization of item customization options and notes
Showcase.feature3Desc: Monitor live orders, popular dishes, and branch revenue from one screen, switching between locations in seconds.
Showcase.feature3Alt: 3D visualization of the multi-branch performance analytics dashboard
Showcase.footnote: Update your menu centrally once, then apply pricing and availability rules to each branch location.

Operations.eyebrow: One Ecosystem, From Scan to Decision
Operations.title: Guests enjoy a quick path. Your team gets the full picture.
Operations.description: DineHub bridges the moment of ordering with kitchen preparation, service dispatch, and branch reporting—without locking you into rigid POS hardware.
Operations.cap1Desc: Guest choices and special requests flow directly to staff in a clean, unified stream.
Operations.cap2Title: Every branch connected to the whole
Operations.cap2Desc: Autonomous branch operations when needed, with aggregated reporting for broader strategic clarity.
Operations.cap3Title: A system shaped around your service model
Operations.cap3Desc: Menus, availability, modifiers, and pricing conform to your workflow, not the other way around.
Operations.illustrationAlt: System illustration showing an order traveling from customer phone to staff terminal and across connected branches
Operations.illustrationCaption: Conceptual diagram of the platform architecture, not an exact UI screenshot.

UseCases.title: We don't force you into a mold. We build around your concept.
UseCases.titleLine1: We don't force you into a mold.
UseCases.description: Different hospitality models plug into the exact same backbone, preserving each brand's character, pace, and service style.
UseCases.constellationAria: Various hospitality service models connected to a single DineHub core
UseCases.coreDesc: Tailors the flow to your service model
UseCases.venueCafeDesc: Sizes, milk alternatives, flavor shots, and organized pickup
UseCases.venueRestDesc: Flexible ordering tailored to table seating or counter service
UseCases.venueBakeryDesc: Clear batch prep before guests arrive at the counter
UseCases.venueShopDesc: From barcode/QR scan to payment in the fewest possible taps
UseCases.responsiveDesc: From customer mobile devices to touch POS terminals, the interface remains tactile, clear, and responsive from 320px to large monitors.

FinalCta.kicker: Ready for a faster ordering flow?
FinalCta.title: Make your guest's first interaction faster than waiting in line.

Footer.tagline: Frictionless for guests. Total command for your team.
Footer.badge: Crafted with mobile-first and bilingual precision.
